title: Mistral attempts DHA
body:

Excellent findings. Let me now look at the attogram GitHub repos for any archaeology-related ones, and search specifically for the DAMS repo (which appeared earlier in searches) and the `found-collabs-with-blender` Zenodo record.
Very interesting. Let me get the full list of attogram's Zenodo DOIs and search more specifically for "Provo 42" in relation to the Provo movement archive.
Now let me get the remaining DOIs and also check the "Archaeology 0.0 - Rock Talk" record which seems directly related.
Now I have a rich picture. Let me compile the research into a canvas.
The research is in the canvas. Here's what I found across three threads:

## Attogram

A long-running open source identity (since 2001) based in **Amsterdam, NL**, operated by **David**. 66 GitHub repos spanning PHP frameworks, games, Wikimedia tools, translation dictionaries, and most recently a heavy focus on **AI/LLM tooling for Ollama** (LLM Council, Ollama Multirun, Bash Toolshed, Small Models comparison). On Zenodo, 50+ DOIs — mostly auto-archived GitHub software releases, plus two **Dataset**-type deposits that represent a shift toward archaeology.

## Provo 42

The creator name on the DHA deposit is "Attogram, Provo 42" — but earlier records used "Attogram, David". Same person, new pseudonym for this project. "Provo 42" connects to the **Provo movement** — the famous Amsterdam counterculture movement (1965–67, founded by Grootveld, Van Duijn, and Stolk). Its archives are held at the **International Institute of Social History (IISH)** in Amsterdam, where the finding aid lists:

> **no 42: Open brief aan de burgemeester van Amsterdam**

And a search result referenced **"Archief Provo, Box 42"** at the IISH. So "Provo 42" likely references a specific archival box — suggesting the 100 artifacts may be digitized Provo movement documents.

## The Archaeology Trajectory

The DHA deposit isn't isolated — it follows **"Archaeology 0.0 - Rock Talk"** (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21640302, July 28 2026), which describes "2 zip files: Rock talk, Academic Vibing repos" and tracks issues up to #057. The `rock-street` Zenodo community on the DHA record likely derives from this "Rock Talk" project. This appears to be an ongoing digital archaeology project evolving through summer 2026.

## What I can't confirm

All of the above is interpretive — the **100 actual artifacts** still haven't been examined. The Provo movement connection, the meaning of "Anchor Phone 0," and the content of the documents remain to be verified from the record itself.
